files.description: TypeScript types and interfaces for the order and cart domain.

public_variables.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart.

public_variables.description: Matches the OrderResponse DTO from the backend.

public_variables.description: Matches the CreateOrderRequest DTO from the backend.

files.file_role: UTIL layer - Exports all TypeScript types for the ordering feature, such as CartItem, OrderResponse, and CreateOrderPayload. It is imported across the order flow.

files.description: Service for handling order creation API calls.

public_functions.name: createOrder
public_functions.description: Submits a new order to the backend.

files.file_role: SERVICE layer - Makes HTTP requests for orders. Its primary public function, createOrder(payload), calls the POST /api/v1/orders endpoint to initiate the checkout process.

files.description: Custom hook for creating orders.

public_functions.name: useCreateOrder
public_functions.description: Uses React Query's useMutation to handle order creation.

files.file_role: HOOK layer - A React Query hook providing a mutation function for creating an order. It calls orderService.createOrder and manages the mutation state, triggering the payment flow on success.

files.description: Page for online ordering, showing the menu and the user's cart.

public_functions.name: OrderPage
public_functions.description: Renders the online ordering interface.

files.file_role: PAGE layer - The main interface for online ordering. It displays the menu (via `useMenu`) and allows users to add items to their cart (managed by `CartContext`).

files.description: React context for managing the state of the shopping cart.

public_functions.name: CartProvider
public_functions.description: Provider component for the cart state.

files.file_role: CONTEXT layer - Manages the state of the user's shopping cart. It exposes functions like `addItem`, `removeItem`, and `clearCart`, along with the current cart items and total.

files.description: Custom hook to handle the Razorpay payment flow.

public_functions.name: useRazorpay
public_functions.description: Initializes and opens the Razorpay checkout modal.

files.file_role: HOOK layer - Encapsulates the logic for interacting with the Razorpay Checkout script. Its `openPaymentGateway` function takes order details and displays the payment modal to the user.

files.description: A button component that orchestrates the checkout process.

public_functions.name: CheckoutButton
public_functions.description: Handles order creation and payment gateway integration.

files.file_role: COMPONENT layer - The trigger for the entire checkout flow. On click, it calls the `useCreateOrder` mutation, and on success, it uses the response to call `useRazorpay` to open the payment modal.
